description: This file is a CLI script for initializing various software projects using the 'universalinit' package. It handles command-line arguments, creates project configurations, retrieves template initialization info, and outputs JSON results. It includes functions for parsing parameters, converting information into dictionaries, and managing project setup workflows.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Holds project template initialization details, including commands and environment settings.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration for a project being initialized.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Provides methods to handle and parse project type strings.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating templates and initializing projects.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriate data types.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig instance for retrieving template info, given project type and parameters.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a base directory.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary suitable for JSON serialization, with absolute paths.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Formats and prints a JSON response indicating success/failure and message, optionally including template info.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a given project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the --get-run-command CLI argument to retrieve the run command for a project type.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point for CLI parsing and project initialization or retrieval of run command.

ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
